title: Managed Database: original payment refunds
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database original payment refunds applies to database refund. The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment. Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment. A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced. Use refund methods, require at least refund minimum, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out. A smaller positive balance remains on account. Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure. Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund. A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Evidence: refund consent
The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, authorization request reference, original source reference, status, database contract reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, authorization request reference, original source reference, database contract reference. 

## Hypothetical refund limit
Hypothetical inputs: net receivable is negative USD 90, the original completed payment is USD 100, its prior returns total USD 30 and its prior refunds total USD 20. The balance magnitude is USD 90 and unused original principal is USD 50. The refund limit is USD 50. A request for USD 60 exceeds this limit and is refused rather than reduced.
